keynotes.text: Main Hand Book of Materia Medica and Homopathic Therapeutics. By T. F. Allen. Presented by Médi-T . Cucurbita. A tincture is made of the fresh stems of the pumpkin, Cucurbita Pepo, L. An emulsion of the seeds is given for tape-worm. Clinical :- ► A tincture of the vines and of the seeds has bees prescribed with alleged benefit in vomiting of pregnancy, and it also has cured vomiting of food and salivation in non-pregnant women. ► The seeds have been used very extensively for tape-worm.
